step_dt_evidence: Phase 12 live episodes control/outputs/vla_episode_004 (n=182) and vla_episode_20260930_121123 (n=54): median step-to-step wall clock 0.785 s over 236 non-stall ticks (episode 121123 alone: median 0.783 s). The nominal --control-hz 2.0 would be 0.5 s; latency_ms.action_to_execution alone is 640-690 ms (50 interpolated waypoints at --execution-hz 100 plus driver latency).

chunk_len_derivation.lower_bound: N >= 10, so each call buys >= ~8 s of motion (10 x 0.785 s = 7.9 s) against the ~6 s depth fetch and per-call overhead.
chunk_len_derivation.upper_bound: N <= 20, so open-loop execution stays under ~16 s (20 x 0.785 s = 15.7 s) and the default 60-tick --max-steps budget allows >= 3 closed-loop calls (D-08).
chunk_len_derivation.not_measured: MLLM API latency (Phase 12 measured only the VLA bridge and depth). Re-derive chunk_len from the per-call latency_ms.api in the episode records after the first live calls, per Plan 15-10.

notes: Shared defaults for every MLLM backend (Phase 15); a backend's own backend_configs/<name>.json may override any key (dict-valued keys sampling/depth/prices merge one level deep), per D-02. chunk_len is a FIXED N the prompt asks for exactly (D-17); the model never chooses it, so it cannot become a cross-backend confound. step_dt_s is the MEASURED 0.785 s tick, not the nominal 0.5 s from --control-hz 2.0 (D-24): the prompt states N steps = N*0.785 s (20 steps = 15.7 s), and every call record also logs the measured tick period of the previous chunk (prev_chunk_tick_period_s). With chunk_len 20 a 60-tick episode allows only 3 calls, so raise --max-steps for MLLM runs. sampling is the shared nominal setting (D-20); providers that fix it omit it and log requested-vs-applied. depth_presentation heatmap|grid|both (D-28) and left_image_source raw|aligned (D-26) are Phase 16 ablation toggles.
